space_ink_review.interpretation: Long horizontal/vertical neutral ink inside the submitted space, not detected walls. Inspect the complete clean room and both sides of each line. It may be a partition, furniture, text or other drawing mark. No strokes is not proof of an open or correctly partitioned space.
limits: Only axis-aligned, high-support neutral lines at the reported filter settings are sampled; oblique, short, interrupted or low-contrast lines may be missed.
Inset boundary bands are excluded. Results depend on the submitted room polygon; unbuilt rooms outside it are not searched.
No wall classification, room count, automatic repair or acceptance verdict.
space_ink_review.follow_up: Use view_image with the original image name and a flagged room's original_box for additional clean context. Recheck whether the original has one physical space or separate rooms; revise the saved plan only when supported. Preserve real apertures and other rooms. Zero strokes is not a fidelity pass.

scope: agent-supplied geometry to independent source BIM; no correction run or solver stage

source_geometry_self_consistency.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

agent_assumptions: Interior door heights assumed 2.1m (floor+2.1) with no plan/elevation dimension for interior doors on this floor.
Partition and door jamb pixel positions read from zoomed crops and wall-color detection; sub-100mm placement uncertainty remains.
South-wall 2F window x-spans taken from South_view.png dimension chain and mapped onto plan pixel coordinates via the shared 15000mm calibration; not independently re-measured in 2f_view.png pixels.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: Exact vertical extent/thickness of the P_top vestibule (two close parallel lines) simplified to a single centerline; possible small storage nook there not modeled.

Bottom-row window count/positions (WS1-WS4) rely on South_view.png dimension chain rather than direct 2f_view.png pixel measurement; not cross-checked against 2f_view.png window graphics pixel-by-pixel.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound view_image returns are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.

plan_compilation.basis: 15000mm/8000mm outer footprint from dimension-line arrows in 2f_view.png; anchors at outer wall face pixel corners (matches gray wall bbox extents from pixel-color detection). Partitions at x~1097px (between the two large meeting rooms, matching visible double-door vestibule) and x~774px, x~1467px (bottom row dividers) from gray-wall region bboxes. Door positions read from zoomed crops of arc/jamb graphics adjacent to each partition. Window spans on north/south walls from labeled dimension chains; west/east single corridor windows from West_view.png/East_view.png 3400-4600mm span, matching corridor depth on this floor too.
